title: LuckRead Social Relationship Read DTO Contract
purpose: Canonical bounded response DTOs for SOCIAL-002 followers/following queries.
rules: The list returns relation members only; account state, layer, moderation state and counters are not exposed by this DTO.
Ordering is createdAt DESC, relationshipId DESC at the authoritative query boundary; relationshipId remains internal.
The opaque cursor must encode the last authoritative (createdAt, relationshipId) position and is not client-interpretable.
Maximum page size is 50 even though the repository-wide generic Limit component permits larger values elsewhere.
The authoritative source is the existing D1-02 social_follow_relationships table; no projection table is introduced by this DTO.
Block, mute and relationship-visibility policy must be evaluated before exposing list members.
A missing or unavailable policy authority fails closed; no client-supplied visibility decision is accepted.
